cases.purpose: Compare user/PID union and intersection with a distinct mapped account, name and numeric UID, and argument order.
cases.oracle: Native lsof and procfs on two live owned children; nobody must resolve to a distinct UID.
cases.comparison: Native selection is controlled for every case before checking candidate selection; raw observations are retained. Missing account or namespace prerequisites are incomplete.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-lsof-r1.py
/usr/bin/cat /proc/sys/user/max_user_namespaces >"$HOME/userns-limit.raw" || exit 98
if [[ -r /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone ]]; then /usr/bin/cat /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone >"$HOME/userns-policy.raw"; else printf 'absent\n' >"$HOME/userns-policy.raw"; fi
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --pid --fork --mount-proc /usr/bin/python3 "$H" control
